product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform that helps in-house legal teams and businesses create, review, sign, manage, and automate contracts.
product_one_liner.notes: The product description and workflows are stated on SpotDraft’s homepage.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page explains volume-based flexible pricing, though it does not publish specific prices.

named_customers.notes: All three are identified on SpotDraft’s customer stories or case-study pages.

employee_band.notes: SpotDraft’s LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: SpotDraft identifies Bengaluru, India as its headquarters; it also has a New York office.

founded_year.notes: Company materials say SpotDraft was founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible blog index and categories chiefly present legal/CLM insights, product updates, company news and employee stories; research did not establish two technical engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The company site links to a Help Center, which provides public help documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A Product Manager - AI job listing appeared on SpotDraft’s Ashby job board.

model_provider.notes: SpotDraft describes its AI capabilities and privacy-first on-device AI but does not publicly identify an underlying model or model provider on the product/company information reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001; it also states GDPR compliance. GDPR is included because the requested list specifies certifications/standards named on-page.

last_funding.notes: SpotDraft announced an $8 million Qualcomm Ventures investment as a Series B extension in January 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 2026 Series B extension falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live SpotDraft Global SDR Manager posting was published October 30, 2026; SDR is explicitly in the title.

launched_6mo.notes: SpotDraft announced Salesforce Integration v2.0 on September 30, 2026, and its Fall Release ’26 page describes newly launched product capabilities. Both are within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A report around December 2025 says SpotDraft appointed two senior executives; the company’s leadership page lists CMO Alon Waks and CFO Amit Sharma. This is within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: SpotDraft’s integration material explicitly identifies both HubSpot and Salesforce.
